visualReview.method: Direct visual inspection of the full-size Japanese and English H-1 captures at playback time 8 s with Performance area on: performer 01's diabolo is airborne above the stage with the slack string between the sticks, performer 04's balls, performer 05's clubs and performer 06's rings are in hand or in flight, and the outside performer 03 does not perform. Prop motion itself (continuity, release speed, spins) was checked by tests/act-props.test.mjs and in Chromium and WebKit by tests/act-props-browser.cjs.
visualReview.limits: Chromium captures of the bundled feature-test show at 1440x900; Safari, iPad and the Mac app not tested; the owner's visual review of the motion is pending
